chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Personnel and family at the Santa Monica College concert
summary: He lists the musicians and his family members who performed at the concert.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Would you give me the names on the tape of everyone who was on your concert, the whole group? The concert was at Santa Monica College in March, on the eve of your birthday.

Well, I think that will be easy. On piano was Gerald Wiggins; on drums was Bill Douglass; Charles Owens played the saxophone; John Carter played clarinet; Alan Robertson played French horn; Al Aarons, flugelhorn. That covers all the musicians. Then there was my wife, Mary Lou, singing, and two daughter, Sharon and April, singing, and my son, Craig, played a little...on one tune he played the Fender bass.
That was the first time I'd ever heard him. I'd heard Mary Lou and Sharon and April at a concert at Los Angeles City College.
Mmm-hmm. So I managed to do a real nepotism act. I got the whole family in.
And you had an overflow audience.
